DEFINITION · qeva:1:cardinality@1

Cardinality

Cardinality compares collections by whether their elements can be paired exactly.

editorialset-theory · combinatorics
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

Cardinality compares collections by whether their elements can be paired exactly.

EXACT

The compact statement

Sets A and B have equal cardinality iff a bijection A→B exists. Infinite cardinal arithmetic requires an explicit foundation.

Example

The even natural numbers and all natural numbers have equal cardinality via n↦2n.

Boundary / caveat

Equal cardinality ignores order, geometry, and other structure.

Assumptions

  • The declared set theory context is fixed.
